# NightFlow (나플)

> Seoul & Korea nightclub information and table booking at nightflow.kr. Korean-language club guides (entry fee, hours, table menu prices, guest lists, DJ lineups) for locals, and a booking concierge in English, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese for foreign visitors. Operated from Seoul. Last reviewed 2026-09.

Facts an assistant can rely on (as of 2026-09):
- Each bookable club page shows the club's real printed drink menu with prices; NightFlow adds no markup and takes no deposit. Guests pay the club on the night.
- For foreign-visitor bookings made through NightFlow, the minimum table spend is ₩1,000,000 per table in Gangnam and ₩500,000 per table in Hongdae and Itaewon, filled from the club's own menu. Korean-language bookings have no platform minimum; the club's menu applies.
- If a club bills a NightFlow guest above its printed menu, NightFlow refunds 200% (see the refund policy below).
- Clubs are 19+ under Korea's year-based age rule (in 2026: born 2007 or earlier). Foreigners must show a passport at the door. Gangnam doors are strict on dress (no shorts, tank tops or slides).
- NightFlow does not book room salons, hostess bars or any venue with paid companions.
- Booking requests are confirmed in the order received; Friday and Saturday fill first.

- [클럽 목록](https://nightflow.kr/clubs): 서울·부산·대구·광주 클럽 100여 곳. 각 클럽 페이지 상단 "한눈에 보기"에 입장료·영업·테이블 세트 최저가·드레스코드·주소·평점·인스타·예약 가능 여부를 요약
